A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same retrieval-head study. The text, equations, figures and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching the proof relocated to v4 Appendix B.

before.justification: v2 reports original LLM accuracy benchmarks, controlled transformer training, circuit ablations and attention-emergence measurements in Sections 4 and 7–9 and the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including Figure 2’s LLM benchmarks, the controlled transformer experiments and the supplementary analyses in Appendices C–E.

M1.justification: The retrieval formulation, IC/non-IC objectives, transformer architectures and circuit reverse-engineering procedure remain unchanged. v2 Appendix D’s procedure is retained in v4 Appendix E.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate equations, lives-with, kingdoms, functions and relatives formulations, alongside the same synthetic retrieval tasks used for controlled transformer training. No dataset, domain or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Figure 2 retains GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro and Llama 3.1 405B for equations, and GPT-4o for the other four formulations. Random-guessing references and IC/non-IC comparisons are unchanged.

E3.justification: The 500-question evaluations, acceptable-answer filtering, synthetic-data construction, model configurations, training budgets and metrics are unchanged. Appendix A.3 corrects grammar in the displayed kingdoms prompt without reporting a substantive protocol revision.

E4.justification: The curriculum/depth study, circuit analyses, attention-emergence trajectories and combined and individual-path ablations are retained. v2 Appendices B–D correspond to v4 Appendices C–E without additional analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions report eight runs per depth and formulation and the same averaging in Figure 4. No repeated-run counts, seed information, uncertainty estimates or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: The corresponding experimental plots, circuit diagrams and appendix results are unchanged. In both versions, Transformer D has MSE 0.031 before ablation and 0.045 afterward; removing useful attention paths yields the same reported 0.17–0.89 range.

T1.justification: v4 Appendix B preserves v2’s definitions, lemmas and proof of the log3(2D) depth bound under the same two assumptions. Section 5 restates the theorem and summarizes its intuition; no mathematical result or proof is substantively revised.

C1.justification: The abstract and contributions retain the same claims about retrieval tasks, logarithmic depth requirements, LLM performance without fine-tuning, retrieval-head mechanisms and curriculum-guided emergence. The conclusion’s wording changes do not alter these claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations of sequential head emergence, natural-language curricula and emergent abilities remain unchanged. Both retain the same limitations concerning generalization to LLMs and incomplete understanding of training dynamics. Section 5’s new intuition summarizes existing reasoning.

D1.justification: The reported hyperparameters, data-generation details, checkpoint schedule and ablation instructions are unchanged, including the procedure moved from Appendix D to E. No new code or data access information is supplied.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are retained. Section 11 explicitly attributes the translation argument to Olsson et al., clarifying an already cited discussion without substantively changing the paper’s relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: Section 5 replaces the detailed proof with the theorem and a short intuitive explanation, relocating the proof to new Appendix B and renumbering subsequent appendices. Other edits are limited to affiliations, grammatical corrections and small wording and attribution refinements.

P2.justification: New Figure 8 repeats Figure 3 beside the relocated proof. Existing figures shift within the revised pagination, including Figures 4–7, while their graphics, axes, legends and substantive captions remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 provides a clearer entry point to the depth bound through Section 5’s concise theorem statement and added intuition, while preserving the complete proof in Appendix B. Small language corrections further improve readability. These are modest presentation gains; the scientific evidence and substantive limitations remain unchanged.
